summary: SiteProfileHistory maintains records of changes to site profiles.
purpose: To track historical changes and actions performed on site profiles.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Retrieval
steps: Execute stored procedure to fetch site profile history
Populate and return list of site profile entries

business_rules: Cancel retrieval if user session is invalid
validations: Check that SiteID and UserSession parameters are set

conditions.description: Cancel selection if UserSession is null

system_behavior: Records changes in site profiles and retrieves historical data
exceptions: Null UserSession leads to procedure cancellation
